newPlatforms.name: MOCRadio Network Free Indie MP3 Email Airplay Route
newPlatforms.country: United States (West Palm Beach, Florida); MOCRadio is an online station with worldwide listenership, while artist-location eligibility is not explicitly stated.
newPlatforms.submissionMethod: official first-party public music-submission mailbox for clean MP3 radio-airplay review

authorizedRoute.explicitPurpose: Submit a clean MP3 for possible MOCRadio airplay and the unsigned/indie Music Discovery Radio programme.
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, passive verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Select a suitable clean MarcsMusic track, review rights and eligibility, prepare the requested metadata and Twitter information, and send only after explicit owner approval.
authorizedRoute.internationalAcceptanceEvidence: MOCRadio describes worldwide listenership and global programming, but the submission page does not explicitly state that artists outside the United States are eligible.
authorizedRoute.standardRouteFeeEvidence: The standard submission page asks artists to email music for review without publishing a fee. Separate promotional packages for guaranteed exposure and live interviews are optional paid services.

publishedRequirements: submit a radio or clean version
rename and tag the file as Artist - Song Title
submit music that fits MOCRadio programming
submissionRequirements.publishedReviewTiming: No response or review-time guarantee is published for the standard editorial route.
safeReviewScope: confirm the track is a radio or clean version
confirm MP3 filename and metadata follow Artist - Song Title
confirm master, composition, sample and contributor rights
confirm AI-assisted and fully generated music eligibility
exclude optional guaranteed-exposure promotional packages unless separately authorized
approve the final email text and attachment before sending

maximum attachment size and number of tracks
whether a streaming or download link is accepted instead of an MP3 attachment

emails.purpose: First-party music-submission mailbox published specifically for MP3 airplay review.

adjacentEmailsExcluded: lc@mocradio.com is a first-party program and music director contact but is not the published submission mailbox
advertise@mocradio.com is an advertising-sales mailbox and is not a music-submission route
businessContact.emailStatus: mp3@mocradio.com is first-party published, syntactically valid, domain aligned and explicitly designated for music submissions.
businessContact.verification: Email verification was limited to first-party publication, syntax, domain alignment and stated purpose. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.captchaStatus: No form or CAPTCHA is part of the published standard email route.
formBoundary.loginStatus: No account or login is required for the published email route.
formBoundary.paymentStatus: No payment is published for standard editorial review. Optional promotional packages for guaranteed exposure are adjacent paid services and are excluded from this queue entry.
formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: Human review is required for track selection, clean-version confirmation, rights and AI eligibility, international eligibility, final email content, attachment handling and separation from optional paid promotion.
adjacentRoutesExcluded: lc@mocradio.com program and music director mailbox

activityVerification.evidence: The first-party home page publishes a current weekly presenter and mix-show schedule, the program/music-director page lists ongoing daily and weekend shows, and an external podcast index lists a MOCRadio episode aired on June 20, 2026.

genreFitEvidence: The first-party submission page identifies Grown Folk Hip-Hop, R&B and a weekly unsigned/indie Music Discovery Radio programme.
The first-party advertising page lists Adult Contemporary R&B, House, EDM, Hip-Hop, Indie Music, Reggae and Slow Jams.
Selected MarcsMusic electronic, house, reggae, hip-hop-adjacent and crossover tracks may fit after a human confirms clean-edit and programme suitability.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is active and first-party, but it requires a human-composed email and MP3 attachment, clean-version and metadata checks, rights and AI-policy review, confirmation of international eligibility, and explicit owner approval. Optional paid promotional packages must remain outside the free editorial-review route.

dedupeTerms: MOCRadio Network Free Indie MP3 Email Airplay Route
deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The accessible repository code-search surface and the open pull-request patch contained no MOCRadio, mocradio.com or mp3@mocradio.com match before creation.
deduplication.consolidation: The MP3 submission mailbox, Music Discovery Radio programme, general program-director contact and optional paid promotional packages are represented as one canonical MOCRadio opportunity with the non-submission and paid routes excluded.

notes: One MOCRadio opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No email was sent, no MP3 was attached, no account or login was used, no CAPTCHA was solved and no payment or submission action was completed.
